notes.title: Electrogene - Creative mode fix
notes.content:
Electrogene just got a small update!

Here are the changes:

Fixed the spikes on bottom and top of the map on creative mode, now touching them will make the player die.
Fixed the tiles angle, now the tiles that you create with different angles will work.

Please note that the maps you created will need to be edited and fixed the tile angle, after doing so, save it and it will work fine.
